headline: Price tailwinds support earnings; refinery commissioning to drive next phase of growth

highlights: Going ahead, we expect higher alumina realisations of ~INR 35,000/t in H2FY27, normalisation of input costs despite the rise in caustic soda and CPC prices, and volume growth supported by the commissioning of the 1mtpa refinery (by late Dec’26/early Jan’27) to support earnings.
There is no material change in estimates and we keep our TP intact at INR 400 (6.0x FY28E EV/EBITDA).
EBITDA grows on higher aluminium profitability NALCO reported Q2FY27 revenue of INR 54.2bn (+26% YoY/+2% QoQ) and EBITDA of INR 24.1bn (+25% YoY/-11% QoQ).
Management expects FY27 alumina production of ~2.45mt and captive coal production of 4.8mt.
valuation: There is no material change in estimates and we keep our TP intact at INR 400 (6.0x FY28E EV/EBITDA).
Refinery commissioning to drive FY28 earrings NALCO is progressing with the commissioning of its 1mtpa alumina refinery, with integrated trials targeted by late December 2026/early January 2027.
Meanwhile, the proposed brownfield smelter expansion at Angul entails an investment of INR 170-180bn, with commissioning targeted by FY31-32.
watch: Key risks • Moderation in alumina or aluminium realisations amid potential increase in global supplies. • Delays in commissioning and ramp-up of the fifth alumina refinery.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
